scope: Primary prepared Caris tissue report and Caris Assure blood report compared with website molecular summary. Clinical calls are kept distinct from research locus/vaccine evidence. No new clinical reclassification.

sources.specimen: Rectal biopsy collected 27 March 2024; report dated 3 June 2026. Superficial, predominantly intramucosal carcinoma; rare definite invasion.
Blood collected 27 January 2026; report dated 6 February 2026.

smad4_source_boundary: G359E is omitted from the selected printed Caris clinical variant tables. The original provider VCF exact-target record independently carries CI=VUS, verified in the retained extraction. Display the provider VCF annotation and investigator overall VUS separately, without implying the printed clinical report lists G359E. The report says additional VUS/unclassified alterations may be in the portal; omission is not absence.

missing_items.finding: SMAD4, SMAD2, BCL2, SETBP1 and ZNF521 are explicitly listed as indeterminate CNA results.
missing_items.interpretation: No definitive loss/amplification or allelic configuration follows. Especially relevant to the unresolved SMAD4 second-hit question.

missing_items.finding: AURKA and GNAS are labelled intermediate CNA results on main page4 but indeterminate in the first appendix page20 table.
missing_items.interpretation: Preserve the source-label discrepancy. Neither table supplies a definitive numerical amplification call.

missing_items.finding: Low; 5% of tested genomic segments show LOH; assay threshold ≥16%.
missing_items.interpretation: A genome-wide aggregate, distinct from negative HLA-A LOH and from locus-specific SMAD4 status; not a proven PARP-response marker.
Historical biopsy RNA classification; do not substitute for current-lesion biology. Report states CMS classification is not recommended for clinical practice in cited 2024 guidance.

missing_items.finding: ATP6AP2, COL2A1, DACH1, MDH2, PLCB4, PRDM6, PRKD1, RASA1, RXRA and SMARCA2 have indeterminate DNA results due to low coverage of some/all exons.
missing_items.interpretation: Do not treat these genes as negative.

missing_items.finding: EGFR, NF1, PIK3CA and POLE mutation not detected. EGFR and ERBB2 amplification not detected.
missing_items.interpretation: Historical assay-specific negatives; not proof against later resistance.

missing_items.finding: No variants detected; total activity score2.0; normal metabolizer.
missing_items.interpretation: Reported pharmacogenomic result; does not eliminate fluoropyrimidine toxicity risk.

missing_items.finding: Buffy-coat gDNA predicts A*02:01/A*02:01, B*44:02/B*07:02, C*05:01/C*03:04, concordant with tissue prediction.
missing_items.interpretation: Supports the same class-I genotype in blood; assay still recommends confirmatory HLA typing. Not proof of functional tumour antigen presentation.

missing_items.finding: No incidental pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline variants or clonal hematopoiesis findings reported.
missing_items.interpretation: Limited report scope, not comprehensive germline-negative or all-clonal-hematopoiesis-negative status.

already_correct_biomarkers: Tissue MSS and low TMB5 mutations/Mb.
KRAS/NRAS/BRAF mutations not detected; ERBB2/EGFR amplification not detected; NTRK1/2/3,RET,BRAF fusions not detected.
Tissue predicted class-I HLA and negative HLA-A LOH.
Assure tumour fraction0.0%, no pathogenic tumour-derived somatic variants, TMB/MSI indeterminate.
not_found_in_these_reports: No PD-L1 IHC score is supplied; absence of a score must not be labelled PD-L1 negative.
No explicit SMAD4 G359E clinical classification or VAF.
data_model_gap: Website summary.variant_groups is a curated set of clinically reported variants. Separate vaccine/research records contain SMAD4 G359E, so its presence elsewhere did not automatically create a clinician-facing variant row. The update should add a clearly labelled research interpretation with provenance and keep provider-specific classifications intact.

provider_VCF_annotation.source_kind: Original provider VCF, retained exact-target extraction re-inspected
provider_VCF_annotation.scope: Provider machine-readable annotation in the original Caris biopsy VCF. G359E is omitted from the selected variant tables in the reviewed printed Caris clinical report; this annotation must not be described as a printed clinical-report classification. Original VCF and private identifiers are not redistributed.

clinical_report_copy_number.interpretation: No definitive second-hit, locus deletion or loss of both copies established.
